description: Look up which GSA Multiple Award Schedule(s)/GWAC(s) a contractor holds and its contract number(s) on each. Pass a known `sin` (and `schedule`) to also pull phone/city/state from that SIN's contract-holder listing. Address, email, website, SAM UEI, NAICS, socio-economic/exclusion-list status, and option-period end date are not available from this tool — eLibrary's per-contract detail page that carries them is blocked from our network; the response names this plainly.

contract_number.description: Optional — narrow to one specific contract number when the contractor holds several

contractor_name.description: Contractor/manufacturer name (matched case-insensitively against eLibrary's search results)

schedule.description: Schedule/GWAC number the `sin` belongs to (default "MAS"); only used when `sin` is given

sin.description: Optional — a Special Item Number already known to be held by this contractor (e.g. from gsa_schedule_search), used to additionally pull phone/city/state

name: gsa_contractor_profile
title: Gsa Contractor Profile
